intro.en: A father visits the airline desk to confirm his family's booking to Jakarta. Learn travel words: ticket, booking, visa, plane.
intro.ur: Ek walid airline ke daftar mein Jakarta ki apne ghar walon ki booking pakki karne aate hain. Safar ke alfaaz seekhein: ticket, booking, visa, jahaz.
intro.ar: يَزورُ أَبٌ مَكْتَبَ شَرِكَةِ الطَّيَرانِ لِيُؤَكِّدَ حَجْزَ أُسْرَتِهِ إِلى جاكَرْتا. تَعَلَّمْ كَلِماتِ السَّفَرِ: تَذْكِرَة، حَجْز، تَأْشيرَة، طائِرَة.

dialogue.en: Good morning, please, what do you want?
dialogue.ur: Subah bakhair, tafaddal, aap kya chahte hain?

dialogue.ar: لَدَيَّ حَجْزٌ إِلى جاكَرْتا، هَلْ هُوَ مُؤَكَّدٌ؟
dialogue.tr: ladayya ḥajzun ilā Jākartā, hal huwa muʾakkad?
dialogue.en: I have a booking to Jakarta. Is it confirmed?
dialogue.ur: Mere paas Jakarta ki booking hai, kya woh pakki hai?

dialogue.en: On which airline will you travel?
dialogue.ur: Aap kis airline se safar karenge?

dialogue.en: We will travel with a company from Indonesia.
dialogue.ur: Hum Indonesia ki ek company ke saath safar karenge.

dialogue.en: Please, where are the tickets?
dialogue.ur: Meharbani farma kar, ticket kahan hain?

dialogue.ar: هَذِهِ تَذْكِرَتي، وَهَذِهِ تَذْكِرَةُ بِنْتي، وَهَذِهِ تَذْكِرَةُ أُمّي.
dialogue.tr: hādhihi tadhkiratī, wa hādhihi tadhkiratu bintī, wa hādhihi tadhkiratu ummī
dialogue.en: This is my ticket, this is my daughter's ticket, and this is my mother's ticket.
dialogue.ur: Yeh meri ticket hai, yeh meri beti ki ticket hai, aur yeh meri ammi ki ticket hai.

dialogue.en: And where are the passports?
dialogue.ur: Aur passport kahan hain?

dialogue.en: Here are our three passports.
dialogue.ur: Yeh hamare teenon passport hain.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ مَعَكُمْ تَأْشيرَةُ الدُّخولِ إِلى إِنْدونيسِيا؟
dialogue.tr: hal maʿakum taʾshīratu d-dukhūli ilā Indūnīsiyā?
dialogue.en: Do you have the entry visa for Indonesia?
dialogue.ur: Kya aapke paas Indonesia ka entry visa hai?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، وَهَذِهِ أَيْضاً تَأْشيرَةُ الخُروجِ مِنَ السُّعودِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, wa hādhihi ayḍan taʾshīratu l-khurūji mina s-Suʿūdiyya
dialogue.en: Yes, and here is also the exit visa from Saudi Arabia.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, aur yeh Saudi Arab se exit visa bhi hai.

dialogue.ar: رَقْمُ رِحْلَتِكُمْ ٤٥٠، وَتُغادِرُ الطّائِرَةُ السّاعَةَ الخامِسَةَ مَساءً.
dialogue.tr: raqmu riḥlatikum arbaʿumiʾa wa khamsūn, wa tughādiru ṭ-ṭāʾiratu s-sāʿata l-khāmisata masāʾ
dialogue.en: Your flight number is 450, and the plane leaves at five in the evening.
dialogue.ur: Aapki flight ka number 450 hai, aur jahaz shaam paanch baje rawana hota hai.

dialogue.ar: اِحْضُروا إِلى المَطارِ قَبْلَ ثَلاثِ ساعاتٍ.
dialogue.tr: iḥḍarū ilā l-maṭāri qabla thalāthi sāʿāt
dialogue.en: Come to the airport three hours before.
dialogue.ur: Teen ghante pehle airport pahunch jayein.

dialogue.en: Thank you very much.
dialogue.ur: Bohat bohat shukriya.

dialogue.en: We wish you a happy trip.
dialogue.ur: Hum aapke liye khushgawar safar ki dua karte hain.

q.ur: 'Hawai jahaz' ke liye kaunsa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني وَسيلَةَ سَفَرٍ في الجَوِّ؟

q.en: What does the clerk say at the end?
q.ur: Aakhir mein clerk kya kehti hai?

options: نَتَمَنّى لَكُمْ رِحْلَةً سَعيدَةً (We wish you a happy trip)

q.en: When should the family come to the airport?
q.ur: Khandaan ko airport kab pahunchna chahiye?

intro.en: At passport control the officer asks Yusuf where he comes from, why he came and where he will stay. Learn to answer politely.
intro.ur: Passport control par officer Yusuf se poochta hai ke woh kahan se aaya, kyun aaya aur kahan thehrega. Adab se jawab dena seekhein.
intro.ar: عِنْدَ مَكْتَبِ الجَوازاتِ يَسْأَلُ الضّابِطُ يوسُفَ: مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنْتَ قادِمٌ؟ وَلِماذا؟ وَأَيْنَ سَتُقيمُ؟ تَعَلَّمْ أَنْ تُجيبَ بِأَدَبٍ.

dialogue.en: Peace and Allah's mercy be upon you.
dialogue.ur: Assalamu alaikum wa rahmatullah.

dialogue.ar: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلامُ. هَلْ مَعَكَ جَوازُ سَفَرِكَ يا أَخي؟
dialogue.tr: wa ʿalaykumu s-salām. hal maʿaka jawāzu safarika yā akhī?
dialogue.en: And peace be upon you. Do you have your passport, brother?
dialogue.ur: Wa alaikum assalam. Bhai, kya aapke paas aapka passport hai?

dialogue.en: Yes, here you are.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, tafaddal.

dialogue.en: Where are you coming from?
dialogue.ur: Aap kahan se aa rahe hain?

dialogue.ar: أَنا قادِمٌ مِنْ نيجيرِيا، وَأَنا نيجيرِيٌّ.
dialogue.tr: anā qādimun min Nījīriyā, wa anā Nījīriyy
dialogue.en: I am coming from Nigeria, and I am Nigerian.
dialogue.ur: Main Nigeria se aa raha hoon, aur main Nigerian hoon.

dialogue.en: Have you come to study?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap parhne aaye hain?

dialogue.ar: لا، أَنا قادِمٌ لِلْعُمْرَةِ وَزِيارَةِ المَسْجِدِ النَّبَوِيِّ.
dialogue.tr: lā, anā qādimun lil-ʿumrati wa ziyārati l-masjidi n-nabawī
dialogue.en: No, I have come for Umrah and to visit the Prophet's Mosque.
dialogue.ur: Nahi, main Umrah aur Masjid-e-Nabawi ki ziyarat ke liye aaya hoon.

dialogue.en: How many weeks will you stay in Saudi Arabia?
dialogue.ur: Aap Saudi Arab mein kitne hafte rahenge?

dialogue.en: About two weeks.
dialogue.ur: Takreeban do hafte.

dialogue.en: And where will you stay?
dialogue.ur: Aur aap kahan thehrenge?

dialogue.ar: سَأُقيمُ في فُنْدُقٍ في المَدينَةِ المُنَوَّرَةِ، وَهُوَ قَريبٌ مِنَ المَسْجِدِ النَّبَوِيِّ.
dialogue.tr: saʾuqīmu fī funduqin fī l-Madīnati l-munawwara, wa huwa qarībun mina l-masjidi n-nabawī
dialogue.en: I will stay in a hotel in Madinah, and it is near the Mosque of the Prophet.
dialogue.ur: Main Madinah Munawwarah ke ek hotel mein thehrunga, jo Masjid-e-Nabawi ke qareeb hai.

dialogue.tr: ahlan bika, wa taqabbala llāhu ʿumratak
dialogue.en: Welcome, and may Allah accept your Umrah.
dialogue.ur: Khush amdeed, aur Allah aapki Umrah qubool farmaye.

dialogue.en: May Allah reward you.
dialogue.ur: Allah aapko jazaye khair de.

vocab.ur: Allah aap ko jazaye khair de

q.en: Which phrase means 'May Allah reward you'?
q.ur: 'Allah aap ko jazaye khair de' kaunsa jumla hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ نَقولُها لِمَنْ أَحْسَنَ إِلَيْنا لِنَدْعُوَ لَهُ؟

options: For Umrah and visiting the Prophet's Mosque

intro.en: Hajar, a traveller from Bangladesh, has lost her bag. The airport employee asks about its colour and what is inside. Learn colour, open and lose.
intro.ur: Bangladesh se aayi musafira Hajar ka bag kho gaya hai. Airport ka mulazim uska rang aur andar ki cheezein poochta hai. Rang, kholna aur kho dena seekhein.
intro.ar: ضاعَتْ حَقيبَةُ هاجَرَ، وَهِيَ مُسافِرَةٌ مِنْ بَنْغَلاديش. يَسْأَلُها المُوَظَّفُ عَنْ لَوْنِ الحَقيبَةِ وَما فيها. تَعَلَّمْ كَلِماتِ اللَّوْنِ وَالفَتْحِ وَالضَّياعِ.

dialogue.en: Please, sister, what happened?
dialogue.ur: Tashreef rakhein behan, kya hua?

dialogue.ar: فَقَدْتُ حَقيبَتي في المَطارِ يا أَخي.
dialogue.tr: faqadtu ḥaqībatī fī l-maṭāri yā akhī
dialogue.en: I lost my bag at the airport, brother.
dialogue.ur: Bhai, mera bag airport par kho gaya.

dialogue.en: Where are you coming from?
dialogue.ur: Aap kahan se aa rahi hain?

dialogue.en: I am coming from Bangladesh.
dialogue.ur: Main Bangladesh se aa rahi hoon.

dialogue.en: Do you have the ticket?
dialogue.ur: Kya aapke paas ticket hai?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، هَذِهِ تَذْكِرَتي، وَهَذا جَوازُ سَفَري.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, hādhihi tadhkiratī, wa hādhā jawāzu safarī
dialogue.en: Yes, this is my ticket and this is my passport.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, yeh meri ticket hai aur yeh mera passport hai.

dialogue.en: What colour is the bag you lost?
dialogue.ur: Jo bag aapne khoya, uska rang kya hai?

dialogue.tr: lawnuhā aswad, wa ʿalayhā sharīṭun aḥmar
dialogue.en: It is black, and it has a red ribbon on it.
dialogue.ur: Uska rang kala hai, aur us par laal feeta laga hai.

dialogue.ar: اُنْظُري إِلى هَذِهِ الحَقيبَةِ، أَهِيَ حَقيبَتُكِ؟
dialogue.tr: unẓurī ilā hādhihi l-ḥaqība, a-hiya ḥaqībatuki?
dialogue.en: Look at this bag. Is it your bag?
dialogue.ur: Is bag ko dekhiye, kya yeh aapka bag hai?

dialogue.en: Yes, this is it! Praise be to Allah.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, yahi hai! Alhamdulillah.

dialogue.en: What is in the bag?
dialogue.ur: Bag mein kya hai?

dialogue.tr: fī l-ḥaqībati malābisu wa hadāyā li-usratī
dialogue.en: There are clothes and gifts for my family in the bag.
dialogue.ur: Bag mein kapde aur mere ghar walon ke liye tohfe hain.

dialogue.en: Open it, please.
dialogue.ur: Meharbani karke ise kholiye.

dialogue.tr: tafaḍḍal, hādhihi malābisī wa hādhihi l-hadāyā
dialogue.en: Here you are, these are my clothes and these are the gifts.
dialogue.ur: Tafaddal, yeh mere kapde hain aur yeh tohfe hain.

q.ur: Hajar ke bag mein kya hai?

intro.en: Learn the four directions (east, west, north, south) and practise matching singular words with their plurals, like ticket and tickets.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum chaar simtein (mashriq, maghrib, shimal, junoob) seekhenge aur wahid alfaaz ko unki jama se milayenge, jaise tazkira aur tazakir.
intro.ar: تَعَلَّمِ الجِهاتِ الأَرْبَعَ (شَرْق، غَرْب، شَمال، جَنوب) وَتَدَرَّبْ عَلى مُطابَقَةِ المُفْرَدِ بِجَمْعِهِ، مِثْلَ تَذْكِرَة وَتَذاكِر.

q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني الجِهَةَ المُقابِلَةَ لِلْجَنوبِ؟
أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ هِيَ الجِهَةُ الَّتي تَطْلُعُ مِنْها الشَّمْسُ؟

q.en: What is the plural of تَذْكِرَة?
What is the plural of يَوْم?

intro.en: Learn useful sentence patterns: 'Are you Nigerian?', 'I am coming from...', 'Is the booking on...?', 'Where are you coming from?' and 'What is in the fridge?'.
intro.ur: Kaam ke jumlay seekhein: 'Kya aap Nigerian hain?', 'Main ... se aa raha hoon', 'Kya booking ... par hai?', 'Aap kahan se aa rahe hain?' aur 'Fridge mein kya hai?'.
intro.ar: تَعَلَّمْ تَراكيبَ مُفيدَةً: هَلْ أَنْتَ نيجيرِيٌّ؟ أَنا قادِمٌ مِنْ … هَلِ الحَجْزُ عَلى …؟ مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنْتَ قادِمٌ؟ ماذا في الثَّلّاجَةِ؟

dialogue.en: Are you Nigerian?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap Nigerian hain?

dialogue.ar: لا، أَنا قَطَرِيٌّ، وَأَنا قادِمٌ مِنَ الدَّوْحَةِ.
dialogue.tr: lā, anā qaṭariyy, wa anā qādimun mina d-Dawḥa
dialogue.en: No, I am Qatari, and I am coming from Doha.
dialogue.ur: Nahi, main Qatari hoon, aur main Doha se aa raha hoon.

dialogue.en: What is in the fridge?
dialogue.ur: Fridge mein kya hai?

dialogue.en: There is fruit in the fridge.
dialogue.ur: Fridge mein phal hain.

q.en: How do you ask a man 'Are you Nigerian?'
q.ur: Mard se kaise poochte hain 'Kya aap Nigerian hain?'
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَسْأَلُ رَجُلًا: هَلْ أَنْتَ نيجيرِيٌّ؟

q.en: What does ماذا في الحَقيبَة؟ ask?
q.ur: ماذا في الحَقيبَة؟ kya poochta hai?

q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني ما نَأْكُلُهُ مِنَ الشَّجَرِ كَالتُّفّاحِ؟

intro.en: Listen and repeat. Hear the difference between the short fatha (a) and the long alif (aa), as in بَر and بار. Then listen to verses from the Quran.
intro.ur: Suniye aur dohraiye. Chhoti fatha (a) aur lambi alif (aa) mein farq suniye, jaise بَر aur بار. Phir Quran ki aayaat sunein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ وَكَرِّرْ. مَيِّزْ بَيْنَ الفَتْحَةِ القَصيرَةِ وَالأَلِفِ الطَّويلَةِ كَما في «بَر» وَ«بار». ثُمَّ اسْتَمِعْ إِلى آياتٍ مِنَ القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ.

q.en: Which word has a long 'aa' sound?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein lambi 'aa' ki awaaz hai?

options_ar: شَخْصٌ يَنْتَقِلُ مِنْ بَلَدٍ إِلى بَلَدٍ

q.en: In Arabic, the short vowel fatha sounds like...
q.ur: Arabi mein chhoti fatha ki awaaz kaisi hai?

intro.en: Practise asking and answering with a partner: booking to a country, where the tickets and passports are, and where you come from and why.
intro.ur: Apne saathi ke saath sawal jawab ki mashq karein: kisi mulk ki booking, ticket aur passport kahan hain, aur aap kahan se aaye hain aur kyun.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ مَعَ زَميلِكَ عَلى السُّؤالِ وَالجَوابِ: الحَجْزُ إِلى بَلَدٍ، وَمَكانُ التَّذاكِرِ وَالجَوازاتِ، وَمِنْ أَيْنَ تَأْتي وَلِماذا.

dialogue.en: Can I help you, brother?
dialogue.ur: Bhai, kya main aapki koi madad kar sakta hoon?

dialogue.ar: لَدَيَّ حَجْزٌ إِلى قَطَرَ، وَأُريدُ أَنْ أُؤَكِّدَهُ.
dialogue.tr: ladayya ḥajzun ilā Qaṭar, wa urīdu an uʾakkidah
dialogue.en: I have a booking to Qatar and I want to confirm it.
dialogue.ur: Mere paas Qatar ki booking hai aur main use pakka karna chahta hoon.

dialogue.en: Do you have the ticket?
dialogue.ur: Kya aapke paas ticket hai?

dialogue.en: Yes, this is my ticket.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, yeh meri ticket hai.

dialogue.en: Are you coming from Africa?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap Afreeqa se aa rahe hain?

dialogue.en: Yes, I am coming from Nigeria.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, main Nigeria se aa raha hoon.

dialogue.en: Have you come to study?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap parhne aaye hain?

dialogue.ar: لا، أَنا قادِمٌ لِلْعَمَلِ مَعَ أَخي في السُّعودِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: lā, anā qādimun lil-ʿamali maʿa akhī fī s-Suʿūdiyya
dialogue.en: No, I have come to work with my brother in Saudi Arabia.
dialogue.ur: Nahi, main apne bhai ke saath Saudi Arab mein kaam karne aaya hoon.

q.ar: أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ تَقولُها إِذا جِئْتَ مِنْ أَجْلِ الوَظيفَةِ؟

options_ar: خُضارٌ أَخْضَرُ طَويلٌ نَأْكُلُهُ في السَّلَطَةِ

q.en: Which question asks 'Where are you coming from?'
q.ur: 'Aap kahan se aaye hain?' kaunsa sawal hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ يَسْأَلُ عَنْ بَلَدِ القُدومِ؟

intro.en: Read short passages about travellers: their nationality, job, passport and why they travel. Then answer questions about them.
intro.ur: Musafiron ke baare mein chhote ibaratein parhein: unki qaumiyat, pesha, passport aur safar ki wajah. Phir sawalon ke jawab dein.
intro.ar: اِقْرَأْ فِقْراتٍ قَصيرَةً عَنْ مُسافِرينَ: جِنْسِيَّتِهِمْ وَمِهْنَتِهِمْ وَجَوازِهِمْ وَسَبَبِ سَفَرِهِمْ. ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ.

q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني مَنْ يُعالِجُ المَرْضى؟

intro.en: Join letters to make words, put words in order to form sentences, and match useful travel phrases. A good way to test yourself on the whole unit.
intro.ur: Huroof jod kar alfaaz banayein, alfaaz ko tarteeb de kar jumlay banayein aur safar ke aham jumlay milayein. Poori unit ko parkhne ka acha tareeqa.
intro.ar: صِلِ الحُروفَ لِتُكَوِّنَ كَلِماتٍ، وَرَتِّبِ الكَلِماتِ لِتُكَوِّنَ جُمَلًا، وَطابِقْ عِباراتِ السَّفَرِ المُفيدَةَ. هِيَ طَريقَةٌ جَيِّدَةٌ لِتَخْتَبِرَ نَفْسَكَ في الوِحْدَةِ كُلِّها.

q.en: What does إِقامَةٌ طَيِّبَة wish someone?
q.ur: إِقامَةٌ طَيِّبَة kis cheez ki dua hai?
q.ar: ماذا نَتَمَنّى لِشَخْصٍ حينَ نَقولُ «إِقامَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ»؟

q.en: Put in order: أَيْنَ / تَأْشيرَةُ / الخُروج
